message:
Hey neighbors! 🌼 As we gear up for our adventures on the road, it’s a great time to think about being prepared before we hit the highway. Having a plan can make all the difference, especially if unexpected bumps come our way. We can use our family group chat to share tips, checklists, and even a few laughs about what snacks to pack! 

Let’s keep those conversations going and make sure we’re all ready for anything that might come up on our journeys. What’s one must-have item you always bring along? 😊
